brand.title: About — INU Media
brand.description: Not an agency. Not a production house. Somewhere in between. INU Media is a Mumbai creative studio where strategy, film, design, performance and PR share one floor.

hero.subtitle: A creative studio for a more human tomorrow.

heading: Not an agency.
Not a production house.
Somewhere in between.
body: INU Media is a creative studio in Andheri West, Mumbai. Writers, directors, designers, editors and media buyers, all on one floor, arguing about the same idea until it is either good or gone.

We took the long way round on purpose. Most of what a brand needs is scattered across five vendors who never meet. We kept all of it in one room, so an idea does not lose its voice every time it changes hands.
story.photoAlt: A quiet night on an INU Media set — one chair, one subject, a wall of lights.
story.stripAlt: Two frames from an INU Media contact strip.

heading: Six disciplines.
One room.
craft.body: Most studios do one of these properly and quietly subcontract the rest. Everything below is made by people who sit within shouting distance of each other.

items.title: Brand & graphic design
items.line: The look a business gets recognised by, everywhere it lands.

items.title: Web design & tech
items.line: Sites and products that load fast and behave themselves on a bad connection.

items.title: Film, music & VFX
items.line: Films, music videos, and the invisible work that holds a frame together.

items.title: Performance & digital ads
items.line: Media bought and read properly, so spend turns into something you can point at.

items.title: Social media & content
items.line: The daily rhythm that keeps a brand in the room between campaigns.

items.title: PR & influencer
items.line: Getting the work talked about by people worth listening to.

heading: Five moves.
No handovers.
process.body: The same five people who argue about the idea are the ones who deliver it. Nothing gets thrown over a wall and comes back a stranger.

steps.name: Ideas
steps.line: We argue about it before anyone opens a design file. If it cannot survive this room, it will not survive an audience.

steps.name: People
steps.line: Casting, crew, client. The work is only ever as honest as the people standing on both sides of the camera.

steps.name: Camera
steps.line: Small units, real locations, and as few pretend things in the frame as we can get away with.

steps.name: Edit
steps.line: Where most of the film actually gets written. Cut, grade, sound and VFX, all under the same roof.

steps.name: Real emotion
steps.line: The only brief that has never changed. If it does not land somewhere in the chest, it goes back.

founder.name: Sahil Kohli
founder.quote: The idea was never to build another agency. It was to build a place where strange ideas could survive.
body: Most of the job is protecting the odd idea in the room — the one everybody likes and nobody wants to be responsible for.
The rest is logistics, and pretending the logistics are not the hard part.
founder.portraitAlt: Sahil Kohli, founder of INU Media, on the rocks at sunset with his film camera.

heading: Good work should
make you feel something.

creed.title: We don't pitch what we can't make.
creed.line: Everything in the deck is something this room can actually shoot, build or run on Monday morning.

creed.title: Brief us on the problem, not the deliverable.
creed.line: Tell us what has to change. Deciding whether that is a film, a site or six months of posts is our job.

creed.title: The work should outlive the campaign.
creed.line: If it stops working the day the media plan ends, we have not finished it.

body: Braver stories. Kinder ideas. A slightly more human tomorrow.
That’s enough of a reason for us.
